song.title: Turner Overdrive-You Ain't Seen Nothing Yet

guitar.notes: Likely 'Bachman-Turner Overdrive' (sample titles confirm BTO songs). Randy Bachman is closely associated with Gibson Les Pauls (and Gretsch early on), though not a single universally iconic guitar like Slash's.

tone.target: dry midrangy classic-rock crunch with slight fuzz bite
tone.profile: dry midrangy classic-rock crunch with slight fuzz bite
tone.summary: A vintage Marshall/Plexi style crunch with a slight fuzz boost for aggressive staccato riffs, maintaining a dry, focused sound.
corrections: name fuzzier bite, not blues overdrive
lean more 70s rock than Vox chime
